correctness.rationale: An explicit free C13 CW quotient has 1 vertex, 6 edge orbits and 18 triangle orbits. Its actual 18 attaching words admit five unit-generator homotopy cancellations, leaving eight null words and five a^13 maps. Thus one Moore 13 space and twelve sphere attachments; the universal-cover R-complex yields I plus twelve R. A standalone standard-library checker reproduces finite-field incidence, face/orbit counts, each attaching word and reductions, ending VERIFY_OK; exact Smith factors 1,1,1,1,1,13 also cross-check homology.

value.rationale: Determines a natural complete two-dimensional orbit-space homotopy type and an integral deck homology module for the canonical Singer symmetry of the first nonbinary projective plane. This provides attaching-map and integral representation structure not determined by the earlier general formula for π1 and ordinary integral homology. The exact homotopy type can anchor computations for related subgroup actions without assuming wider classification.
